records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for setting up Silver Partners on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 (2026-09-14) but no activity since; no invite sent, no tickets, and no reply to two outreach emails (email:105a849c, email:2b1dde8a). Solo Starter admin gone quiet 6 days in with 8 days left — low but not negligible chance of self-serve activation.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

You've got your first project set up in Wrenfield, which is the main hurdle — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The piece that usually makes it click is having a teammate in there with you on shared work; a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever your team's next step looks like.

Best,
Chidi
